api.notes: Plain-text shorthand. The upstream ReactNode label is also the default slot (rich content); the attribute wins when both are present.
Named slot; the wrapper is drawn only when something is slotted.

api.reason: A-xstyle: use class/style, ::part(base|icon|label) or the tokens.

differences.text: Fills come from Tecton roles: neutral is the chip default fill and ink (Tecton maps Badge to its Chip), the four severities use the filled status roles (--tecton-color-status-*-filled-bg / -text), the hue variants keep the tinted --color-background-* / --color-text-* roles. The React theme's extra lime variant is not ported: --tecton-color-accent-lime-fill with the badge contrast ink measures 2.79:1 in light mode.

`label` is a plain-text attribute and the default slot; upstream's ReactNode label maps to the slot. The native title fallback follows upstream: set for a plain-text label (attribute or text-only slot), never for rich content.
The pill carries a transparent 1px border so forced colours draw its edge (the pill loses its fill there); the box height stays 20px (border-box).

core.badge.notes: Guides: [mwg:shadow-dom] slot whitespace and slotchange; [mwg:styling-web-components] parts and private custom properties; [mwg:accessible-web-components] no role, text stays in the reading order; [mwg:contrast-color] evaluated for the lime variant and rejected (fixed Tecton roles only).
